name: cenk
description: Cenk Simsek's public Claude Code plugins. Every plugin is named cenk-<purpose> and installs on its own: take only the one you need.

plugins.name: cenk-overtime
plugins.description: Helps employees who worked unpaid overtime or extra shifts prepare their claim for a lawyer: a case folder in your own Google Drive, your out-of-hours work counted from your own records (email, chat, calls, calendar, git), weekday and weekend apart, and an evidence report for your lawyer to check. Runs in Claude Code on your computer. Not legal advice.

plugins.name: cenk-jobs
plugins.description: Your job search with Claude: finds and screens job postings under your own employer rules, writes CVs and cover letters from your own facts, applies in your own Chrome on its own whenever your records answer every question, tracks every application, puts interviews and deadlines in Google Calendar, and prepares each hiring step. Your data stays in your Google Drive.
